final_text: Average weekly point-of-sale spending in Saudi Arabia was SAR 9.60 bn in Q4 2021, up 19.5% from SAR 8.04 bn in Q4 2020. Average weekly transactions were 115.5 million (up 54.9%), and the average ticket was SAR 83.1 (down 22.8%). The largest movements were: Restaurants & Café increased by SAR 304 mn; Gas Stations increased by SAR 299 mn; Miscellaneous Goods and Services increased by SAR 296 mn.
